name: Ziaur Rahman
role: Sector Commander and Z Force Commander
contribution: He announced the declaration of independence over radio at Kalurghat and later commanded Sector 1, Sector 11, and Z Force in combat operations.
context: Chittagong and multiple fronts during the Liberation War, 1971.
impact: His military and symbolic role helped mobilize resistance in the war’s early phase.
highlight: A battlefield commander with major symbolic wartime visibility.
